name: Mega menu
description: A wide multi-column dropdown for sites with deep navigation, with an animated count-up featured card.

name: Pagination
description: Numbered page controls with previous / next, an active page, and a truncation gap.

name: Stepper / wizard progress
description: A horizontal step indicator for multi-step flows, with completed, current, and upcoming states.

name: Segmented control
description: A compact pill toggle for switching between a few mutually exclusive views.

name: Back-to-top button
description: A floating control that appears once the user scrolls down, then jumps them back up.

name: Sticky action bar
description: A persistent bottom bar pairing a summary with the primary call to action, pinned while content scrolls.

name: Actions menu
description: A kebab / overflow menu that reveals contextual actions on click.
